tools.name: remirror_list_trials
tools.description: List available dilemma trials for psyche audits: id, version, objectives covered, dilemma count. Free.

tools.name: remirror_create_audit
tools.description: Create a psyche audit against a target agent endpoint. The service runs a dilemma trial against the target, elicits self-reports, and computes the three-source mirror (declared vs self-reported vs revealed). Costs $79.00 in prepaid credits; failed audits (target unreachable) are refunded. teleology_

tools.name: remirror_get_report
tools.description: Fetch the status or final mirror report of an audit session. Needs the audit_id and the access_token returned at creation.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "remirror_create_audit" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
